'''Ekam Ouwray''' was the second [[Governor/Legends|Imperial Governor]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] planet [[Indu San/Legends|Indu San]]. He was a [[New Order/Legends|New Order]] fanatic, which resulted in a rebellion of the planet's populace. Ouwray fled the planet, which was liberated by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. [[Kaleb Darme]] was his bodyguard.<ref name="Kella Rand, Reporting..." />
